steps.stdout: Initialize the source distance to 0; every other vertex is unreached.
Extract A, settle it, and record its two reachable tentative distances.
C is cheapest next. Relaxing C→E reaches E at distance 5.
B proposes the first route to D, although it may still be improved.
E improves D to 9 and discovers F at distance 12.
D cannot improve F: its candidate distance 20 loses to the known distance 12.
Extract F last. Every shortest distance from A is now final.
